questions.instructions: Does this diff introduce a plausible unintended change to existing observable behavior that warrants investigation?

criteria.true: The changed logic suggests an unintended behavioral regression worth checking in surrounding code and tests.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication of an unintended behavioral regression.

questions.instructions: Does this diff plausibly weaken an authentication or authorization boundary enough to warrant investigation?

criteria.true: A changed access check or trust boundary may permit an unauthorized operation.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication of weakened access control.

questions.instructions: Does this diff plausibly allow invalid or untrusted input to reach an unsafe operation without adequate validation?

criteria.true: A changed input path may accept unsafe values that merit investigation.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication of inadequate input validation.

questions.instructions: Does this diff plausibly cause unintended loss or corruption of persisted data?

criteria.true: Changed writes, migrations, or transaction behavior may damage persisted data.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication of unintended data loss or corruption.

questions.instructions: Does this diff plausibly mishandle a failure in a way that warrants investigation?

criteria.true: A changed failure path may hide an error, return an incorrect result, or prevent recovery.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication of mishandled failures.

questions.instructions: Does this diff plausibly break an existing external interface or supported consumer contract?

criteria.true: A changed interface, format, configuration, or dependency may break supported consumers.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication of a broken compatibility contract.

questions.instructions: Does this diff plausibly mishandle a resource or operation lifecycle in a way that warrants investigation?

criteria.true: Changed acquisition, cleanup, cancellation, or concurrency may leave an operation or resource in an invalid state.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication of a lifecycle defect.

questions.instructions: Does a changed behavior appear to lack a meaningful regression test that warrants investigation?

criteria.true: A consequential changed behavior appears insufficiently tested and merits checking existing coverage.
criteria.false: The diff gives no meaningful indication that consequential changed behavior lacks regression coverage.
